programme.title: Bon Voyage Charlie Brown (And Don't Come Back)
programme.desc: Charlie Brown heads to Europe as an exchange student in this animated movie based on the "Peanuts" comic strip. programme.title: Dear God
programme.desc: In order to avoid a jail sentence, con man Tom Turner (Greg Kinnear) promises a judge he'll get an honest job for a year. programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: Over the course of 10 days in May 1969, an infantry squad led by Lt.
